name: LLM CHESS
description: LLM CHESS is an evaluation framework that benchmarks reasoning and instruction-following abilities of LLMs through agentic interaction in chess. It ranks models by playing against a random opponent and uses metrics such as win/loss rates, move quality, legality, hallucinations, and game duration, including Elo rating estimates for top models.
reputation: A very recent benchmark with limited but growing attention from the LLM evaluation community, mainly as a specialized agentic reasoning test rather than a standard leaderboard.
notes: Dynamic and stochastic nature reduces overfitting and saturation; includes public leaderboard and dataset of games.
